results.title: ‘Real-world skill sets’ – Sam George makes case for One Million Coders programme
results.content: Communication, Digital Technology and Innovations Minister Sam Nartey George says the One Million Coders programme is designed to equip people with practical skills they can use in everyday life and business.

results.title: A case for a systematic rollout of Ghana’s new traffic law (L.I. 2519
results.content: The Ministry of Transport launched a nationwide education exercise in September 2026, with Transport Minister Joseph Bukari Nikpe acknowledging that nationwide education was “necessary to help drivers, transport operators, motor unions and other road users understand their responsibilities”. But one month of sensitization is certainly not enough time to absorb dozens of new offences and changed penalties.

results.title: Sam George outlines $270m Ghana AI investment, cites risks of feeding government data into foreign models
results.content: The Minister for Communication, Digital Technology and Innovations, Samuel Nartey George, has outlined a $270 million investment in Ghana’s artificial intelligence (AI) development, with $250 million earmarked for infrastructure and computing capacity and the remaining $20 million for seed funding for an AI fund.

results.title: ‘Those who evolve and adapt will survive’ – Sam George on AI and jobs
results.content: The Minister for Communication, Digital Technology and Innovations, Samuel Nartey George, says that workers who fail to adapt to changing technology risk losing their jobs as artificial intelligence (AI) reshapes the world of work.

results.title: African mineral value addition in focus at ‘Mining in Motion Conference’
results.content: The Chief Executive Officer of the Minerals Income Investment Fund (MIIF), Justina Nelson, has highlighted the importance of investment, data sharing and regional cooperation in helping African countries derive greater value from their mineral resources.

results.title: ‘That is a mirage’ – Sam George on foreign cloud data-sovereignty assurances
results.content: Communication, Digital Technology and Innovations Minister Sam Nartey George has challenged assurances that agreements with foreign cloud providers guarantee control over data.

results.title: Black Maidens fight back to hold Brazil in six-goal thriller
results.content: Ghana’s Black Maidens mounted a determined fightback to hold Brazil to a pulsating 3-3 draw on Wednesday night, with Priscilla Mensah striking five minutes from time to deny the South Americans victory at the 2026 FIFA U-17 Women’s World Cup.

results.title: Sam George announces national data exchange hub to connect 48 public registries
results.content: The Minister for Communication, Digital Technology and Innovations, Samuel Nartey George, has announced plans to establish a national data exchange hub to connect 48 public data registries and enable seamless information sharing across government institutions.

results.title: Bleoo ’15 launches ‘Adopt a Classroom’ project to improve learning environment at Accra Academy
results.content: The 2015 Year Group of Accra Academy, popularly known as Bleoo ’15, has launched its signature ‘Adopt a Classroom’ project, an initiative aimed at renovating and modernising classrooms at the school to create a better learning environment for current and future students. The project was announced at a ceremony at the K.G. Konuah Hall of Accra Academy, where Bleoo ’15 was formally inaugurated, marking a new chapter in the year group’s commitment to alumni welfare, school development and service to its alma mater. The ‘Adopt a Classroom’ initiative seeks to mobilise support from old boys, corporate organisations and well-meaning individuals to improve classroom facilities and contribute to the school’s continued pursuit of academic excellence.

results.title: KNUST, MTN sign MoU to strengthen industry-academia collaboration and develop AI talent
results.content: Kwame Nkrumah University of Science and Technology (KNUST) has signed a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) with telecommunications company MTN Ghana to strengthen industry-academia collaboration, equip students with practical skills and develop homegrown solutions to Ghana’s technological challenges.

results.title: NDC dismisses NPP claims over Nadowli 24-hour economy market, touts MP’s development record
results.content: The National Democratic Congress (NDC) in the Nadowli-Kaleo Constituency has dismissed allegations by the New Patriotic Party (NPP) regarding proposed changes to the ongoing 24-hour economy market project, while highlighting the development record of Member of Parliament Anthony Mwinkaara Sumah.

results.title: Cargill Cares Ghana celebrates World Food Day with Cape Coast School for the Deaf and Blind
results.content: Cargill Cares Ghana has celebrated World Food Day with the students and staff of the Cape Coast School for the Deaf and Blind, reaffirming its commitment to community wellbeing, inclusion and the fight against hunger.

results.title: Cashew processors receive training to boost local processing and exports
results.content: The Ghana Private Sector Competitiveness Programme Phase Two is calling for sustained investment in skills development and technology to strengthen Ghana’s cashew processing industry and improve its competitiveness in the sub-region.

results.title: From music to MoMo: ShattaFest puts cashless trading in the spotlight
results.content: MoMoFest x ShattaFest 2026 has brought digital payments to the heart of entertainment, giving festivalgoers and traders at the Accra Sports Stadium a chance to combine music, shopping, and mobile money transactions.

results.title: Rebrand Masterclass urges business leaders to build beyond the founder
results.content: A central question challenged participants to consider whether their businesses could continue serving customers, making decisions, and meeting obligations if they became unavailable for 30 or 60 days.

results.title: Samini launches ‘Samini Xperience 2026’, a week-long festival spotlighting Dansoman
results.content: Scheduled for December 18 to 24, the festival will culminate in a Christmas Eve concert at Carl Reindorf Stadium in Dansoman. The programme also includes a community clean-up, health walk, food bazaar, basketball tournament, talent showcase, fashion event and street carnival.

results.title: MobileMoney Fintech LTD scales up digital finance for 18,000 MSMEs
results.content: MobileMoney Fintech LTD has signed a strategic partnership with the United Nations Capital Development Fund and the United Nations Conference on Trade and Development to expand digital financial services for Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises in Ghana.

results.content: I am here as a woman in her 40s, asking myself a question that has been on my mind since I came across the comments attributed to Daniel Nortey: “ Why are we behaving as if it is not normal to rape someone? Which man hasn't raped a lady before?”

results.title: Togo Navy alerted as Ghana works to secure return of seven missing fishermen
results.content: Authorities are working to secure the safe return of seven crew members of a missing fishing canoe, Second Chance, after their location was established within Togolese territorial waters, Western Regional Minister Joseph Nelson has disclosed.

results.title: SIMI summit reaches 1,000 people with health screenings, NHIS registrations in Bono
results.content: Sustainable Impact Makers International (SIMI) says its 2026 Health Equity Summit reached more than 1,000 people in the Bono Region, combining community advocacy, health education and preventive services to address barriers to healthcare access. The three-day initiative, held in Sunyani from July 23 to 25 under the theme “Health Equity in Action: From Periods to Parenthood, For All,” recorded more than 420 screening encounters across 13 service categories and completed over 500 National Health Insurance Scheme (NHIS) registrations. About 800 secondary school students also participated in a film screening and facilitated discussion on issues including menstrual health, consent, early marriage and school retention.

results.title: Asutifi North sound system operators demand justice for allegedly assaulted colleague
results.content: Sound system operators in the Asutifi North District of the Ahafo Region are demanding the arrest and investigation of two prison officers and three inmates allegedly involved in an attack that left their colleague, Opoku Afriyie, severely injured. The group is calling on the Inspector-General of Police (IGP), the Minister for the Interior and national security authorities to intervene, saying more than a month after the incident, the suspects have not been arrested. Afriyie, a sound system operator, commercial motorbike rider and farmer, was allegedly attacked with machetes by the two officers and three inmates from the Kenyasi Settlement Camp Prison over allegations of yam theft.

results.title: US citizen Stephen Hubbard freed by Russia as Trump envoy meets Putin
results.content: Russia released a 74-year-old American citizen who was jailed for allegedly fighting on behalf of Ukraine, as President Vladimir Putin met US envoy Steve Witkoff in St Petersburg for talks.

results.title: Arrupe Jesuit Institute to strengthen advocacy and youth empowerment
results.content: The Arrupe Jesuit Institute (AJI) has outlined plans to expand its advocacy and youth empowerment programmes under a new strategic plan aimed at increasing its impact on Ghanaian society.

results.title: ‘Corporate Ghana must step up’ – Bel Aqua urges business community to invest in youth mental health
results.content: Corporate Ghana is being challenged to step up investment in mental health support for young people facing depression, grief, and societal pressures, warning that many lack safe spaces to speak openly or access professional help.

results.title: Bel-Aqua’s Healing Together Vigil draws over a thousand for an evening of music and mental health dialogue
results.content: Over a thousand people gathered at Alliance Française in Accra on Friday, 16 October 2026, for Bel-Aqua’s Healing Together Vigil 4.0, an evening combining mental health conversations with live music, comedy and community connection. Held under the theme “Every Mind Has a Story… Respond with Hope”, the fourth edition formed part of Bel-Aqua’s Take a Break initiative. It followed the Healing Together Walk on 3 October, extending the campaign’s call for people to make time for their mental well-being and support those around them. At the heart of the vigil was a message that went beyond encouraging people to speak about their struggles: the response they receive matters just as much. The campaign called for listening without judgment and approaching difficult conversations with empathy, care and hope.

results.title: NACOC takes drug education campaign to Diabene SHS
results.content: The Western Regional Command of the Narcotics Control Commission (NACOC) has launched a drug education and sensitisation campaign targeting newly admitted Senior High School (SHS) students to raise awareness of the dangers of drug use.

results.title: Dagbang chiefs visit Bawumia to express gratitude for regent’s installation
results.content: Former Vice President Dr Mahamudu Bawumia has received a delegation of chiefs from Dagbang at his office, led by the Regent of the Dagbang Kingdom, Kampakuya Naa Yakubu II.

results.title: Ghana, UK make progress in talks to secure IELTS exemption for students, professionals – Ablakwa
results.content: Foreign Affairs Minister Samuel Okudzeto Ablakwa says Ghana has made significant progress in negotiations with the United Kingdom to exempt Ghanaian students and professionals from the International English Language Testing System (IELTS) examinations.

results.title: KNUST Engineering College launches 75th anniversary, eyes Gh¢40m innovation building
results.content: The College of Engineering at the Kwame Nkrumah University of Science and Technology (KNUST) is seeking to deepen collaboration with industry and transform academic research into practical solutions, hinting at the construction of a GH¢40 million Technology and Innovation Building.

results.title: Court of Appeal dismisses Abronye’s bid to halt Samson Lardy Anyenini defamation suit
results.content: The Court of Appeal in Kumasi has dismissed another application by Bono Regional NPP Chairman Kwame Baffoe, popularly known as Abronye, seeking to halt the defamation suit brought against him and Wontumi Multimedia Company Limited by lawyer and journalist Samson Lardy Anyenini. A three-member panel presided over by Justice Eric Baah dismissed the application on Wednesday, October 21, 2026, and awarded GH¢10,000 in costs against Abronye. The application sought a stay of proceedings in the substantive case pending the determination of an interlocutory appeal. The latest ruling marks another setback in Abronye’s efforts to prevent the defamation action from proceeding at the Kumasi High Court.

results.title: 11 Ghanaians rescued in Nigeria after paying GH¢40,000 each over visa scam
results.content: The Ogun State Police Command in Nigeria has rescued 11 Ghanaian nationals allegedly held hostage in Sagamu after they were lured to the country with promises of Canadian and Spanish visas The command disclosed this in a statement issued on Tuesday, October 20, 2026, by its Police Public Relations Officer, Mr Oluseyi Babaseyi. According to the statement, the victims, comprising seven males and four females, were rescued by operatives of the Anti-Kidnapping Unit following actionable intelligence received on October 19, 2026. "Acting on actionable intelligence received on 19 October 2026, operatives of the Anti-Kidnapping Unit immediately mobilised to the identified hideout and safely rescued all eleven victims," the statement said.

results.content: The Tema Development Corporation (TDC) has identified inadequate road access to some of its lands as a major challenge affecting its efforts to expand commercial real estate development.

results.title: Ghana strengthens Ebola surveillance after cases reported in Kenya and Nigeria
results.content: The Ministry of Health says Ghana has intensified surveillance, airport screening and emergency preparedness measures following reports of Ebola cases in Kenya and Nigeria amid an ongoing outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC).

results.title: Family of prison officer killed by IRA receives state apology
results.content: The family of a senior Irish prison officer murdered by the IRA has received a state apology on Wednesday for failings in investigations into his killing.

results.title: Godfred Seidu Jasaw proposes mandatory procurement of prison-made goods by government institutions
results.content: The Chairman of Parliament’s Food, Agriculture and Cocoa Affairs Committee and member of the Public Accounts Committee (PAC), Dr Godfred Seidu Jasaw, has called for a government directive requiring public institutions to purchase a quota of goods produced by inmates of the Ghana Prisons Service. He said the policy would provide a reliable market for prison-based vocational businesses and help the Service generate sustainable income instead of relying heavily on philanthropy and donor support. Dr Jasaw made the proposal during an engagement between the PAC and the Ghana Prisons Service on Wednesday, October 21, 2026, following concerns raised by the Service’s Director-General, Patience Baffoe-Bonnie, about inadequate funding and limited support for its vocational enterprises.

results.title: Government sets November 30 deadline for safeguards under contract mining policy
results.content: The government has set November 30, 2026, as the deadline for the Minerals Commission to complete processes required to implement additional safeguards under Ghana’s contract mining policy.

The directive is part of additional policy measures announced by the Ministry of Lands and Natural Resources to guide […]

results.title: Delayed HIV test results, misconceptions fuel concerns over stigma in Ghana
results.content: Delays in receiving HIV test results and persistent misconceptions about how the virus spreads are raising concerns about Ghana’s efforts to improve HIV services and tackle stigma against people living with the virus. The concerns emerged at the launch of the Community-Led Monitoring (CLM) initiative for HIV, tuberculosis and malaria services, organised by AngloGold Ashanti (AGAMAL). AGAMAL’s Head of Programmes, Malik Kofi Assan, said the initiative would help identify gaps in healthcare delivery and strengthen accountability in services for the three diseases.

results.title: FDA shuts down Arcan Bitters factory again over illegal production
results.content: The Food and Drugs Authority (FDA) in the Ashanti region, has shut down a second factory belonging to Unni Associates Company Limited, manufacturers of Arcan Bitters, after the company allegedly resumed production despite an earlier closure order.

results.title: Residents, school authorities demand footbridge at Aboabo after van killed 4 pupils
results.content: The death of four schoolchildren at Aboabo in the Asokore Mampong Municipality has reignited urgent calls for the construction of a footbridge on the dual carriage road that has become notorious for fatal accidents.
